name: Bedrock AgentCore Role Confusion
description: Bedrock agents use IAM roles for execution. An attacker with iam:PassRole and bedrock:CreateAgent (or bedrock:UpdateAgent) can create or modify an agent to use a privileged role. When the agent is invoked, it executes with that role's permissions. The attacker can configure the agent to use a Lambda function they control, which runs with the agent role and can exfiltrate credentials or perform privileged actions. Required permissions are iam:PassRole and bedrock:CreateAgent or bedrock:UpdateAgent.
